name: KeeNote
description: A secure, local-first note & password manager for the browser, built on [KeePass KDBX](https://keepass.info/help/kb/kdbx_4.html) files and [kdbxweb](https://github.com/keeweb/kdbxweb). Everything runs client-side — no server, no telemetry. Your `.kdbx` database never leaves your machine.
